quest.title: A Certain Trifle
quest.description: Iaune from the Maison Gestion is likely still hard at work...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x3

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: Traveler, glad to see you've come back for another visit. Coffee?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah! Paimon wanted to ask too, but... But those guys were so loud, and Paimon didn't dare talk about anything else...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: And I thought I was going to be kicked out.

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: Why? Hahaha, no need to worry! The guards let you in, so why would we take it upon ourselves to chase you out?

response.speaker: Semaine
response.text: This is also an example of clear delegation of authority and responsibility. Hello, Traveler. I am Semaine, it is a pleasure to meet you.

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: Semaine used to work in the courts as an assistant secretary. Due to some... rather messy circumstances, he was transferred back to the Maison Gestion.

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: Using his logical and precise deductions, we were able to find solutions to many previously intractable problems.

response.speaker: Semaine
response.text: Please, that's a bit much. I merely transferred over my previous work experience, and used the value of certain things to infer the importance of matters related to them.

response.speaker: Semaine
response.text: Though in practice, countless matters that cannot be precisely measured will crop up in the course of work. But in these cases, applying Roialte's well-developed axioms of human interaction is of great assistance.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: And that means... what now?

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: Put simply, when dealing with work, Semaine is quite skilled in considering all sides and their state, and makes everyone feel like they are important. It's like balancing scales.

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: And if the balancing act is simply impossible, then I can tip the scales with the "weight of words."

choices.text: Iaune sure seems to be working hard...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah! It seems like he's about to pass out.

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: This is a path that all must walk, sooner or later. Should I help Iaune write the document, he will not remember this lesson.

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: His head and heart are filled with idealistic fantasies about what working in the Maison Gestion is. But fantasies are for the young, not for Gestionnaires.

response.speaker: Semaine
response.text: And I simply don't know how to write those documents.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You're quite direct...

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: Alright, so what business brings you here? Tell me, and I'll see if I can...

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Iaune suddenly runs over in a panic...

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: Alas! All is doom and ruin! ...Mr. Roialte, do you have spare keycaps for the typewriter?

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: As I was typing, I suddenly discovered that a keycap was missing, I have no idea when it could have...

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: Did you already have a look nearby? Maybe it just fell off onto the ground.

response.speaker: Semaine
response.text: Or maybe it's stuck in a book, or sandwiched between documents... Did you already check these possibilities?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Or maybe it's in a pen holder. Or your sleeve.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Or your hair, or in a teacup!

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: I've looked everywhere! Even my pockets and my shoe bottoms, I've searched all over, and it's nowhere to be found!

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: Very well. Then you should go ask Cornelia. If we do have spares for things like keycaps, then she's the one you need to file a request with.

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: I should just go buy one myself! It shouldn't take Estelle long at all to make a keycap.

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: My dear Iaune, do you really want to spend your own money? The typewriter and its keycaps are public property, and the property of the Maison Gestion. Filing an application with Cornelia is the proper procedure.

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: It really doesn't cost much at all...

response.speaker: Semaine
response.text: This is not a matter of how much. This is another matter of authority and responsibility.

response.speaker: Semaine
response.text: Repairing the public property of the Maison Gestion should be paid for by the public accounts of the Maison Gestion!

response.speaker: Semaine
response.text: If you pay for this with your private funds, and do not file a claim for reimbursement, then when expenses are audited at the end of the year, it will be unclear where the money came from!

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: Fine! Fine! I'll go find Cornelia right now...

choices.text: Even buying something is such a pain...

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: This is actually quite normal around here. Please, this way. Let's go find Cornelia.

choices.text: Is even paying for things this annoying...?
Why were none of you surprised to see me here before?

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Ah... Traveler, it's nice to see you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You have bags under your eyes and it seems like you can barely speak. You should take a break.

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: I... I can't rest. I stayed up all night last night writing drafts, but none were good enough! Time for yet another re-write...

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: If you have any official business you require my assistance with, please wait a moment... You can pull up a chair near Mr. Roialte, perhaps he even has coffee...

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: I... I must get back to writing...

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: Argh! No, using "To my dear colleagues" is certainly not formal enough...

dialogues.speaker: Cornelia
dialogues.text: Hello, Mr. Iaune. May I help you?

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: And hello to you too, Miss Cornelia. Do we have any spare keycaps for a typewriter?

dialogues.speaker: Cornelia
dialogues.text: Excuse me?

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: My typewriter is missing a keycap, so I would like to apply for a replacement. If there isn't one in stock... It would also work if you could reimburse the purchase of a new one.

dialogues.speaker: Cornelia
dialogues.text: Expensing a keycap... That shouldn't be a problem, in principle.

dialogues.speaker: Cornelia
dialogues.text: Sign your name here, please. Just write "Requesting reimbursement for replacement keycap due to typewriter malfunction," and then sign your name and office.

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Very well. I can get the keycap today, right? I really need to get back to work.

dialogues.speaker: Cornelia
dialogues.text: Mr. Iaune, have you ever applied for reimbursement for the purchase of public property before?

dialogues.speaker: Cornelia
dialogues.text: Being reimbursed for work expenses is not at all like you imagine... you don't simply buy something and reimburse it. We need to compile all the reimbursement receipts and documents on a monthly basis, create summary reports, and then submit everything to the Maison Cardinalice for approval at the end of the month.

dialogues.speaker: Cornelia
dialogues.text: This approval process is related to the approval and payment of salaries for the entire Maison Gestion. If the amount expensed is too large, then the Maison Cardinalice will even need to submit it to Monsieur Neuvillette himself for approval.

dialogues.speaker: Cornelia
dialogues.text: Payments can only be officially sent after the review is complete and everything is signed.

dialogues.speaker: Cornelia
dialogues.text: If he has any questions about a certain expense report, the staff member in question must submit a written report... We are just preparing to submit our first batch of reports, which we shall do sometime in the next few days.

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: You mean, if I'm unfortunate enough, then I might require Monsieur Neuvillette himself to sign off on that keycap reimbursement?

dialogues.speaker: Cornelia
dialogues.text: Such are the rules, Mr. Iaune. And since the total expenses for this month are large indeed, he may very well be required to audit the reports.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Monsieur Neuvillette... Wait, isn't that your Chief Justice?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But it's just a keycap... and we're making him sign for it... it just doesn't feel right...

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: I think so too. After all, it's only a keycap, and we don't trouble him with it...

response.speaker: Cornelia
response.text: That is true, there are other ways. Yes... You could go buy a keycap yourself first, then I can provide you an official acknowledgment of debt in the public accounts.

response.speaker: Cornelia
response.text: After all the reimbursements have been processed and the payment process completed, the amount owed will be paid to you directly from the public purse.

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: Excellent! Then let's do that! After all, a keycap doesn't cost much, I can pay for it!

response.speaker: Cornelia
response.text: Then please sign here, and you should still write "Requesting reimbursement for replacement keycap due to typewriter malfunction"... are you going to purchase a replacement from Miss Estelle?

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: Yes, indeed. Is anything wrong?

response.speaker: Cornelia
response.text: Then I will take the IOU to Mr. Roialte for him to sign, and then take it to Miss Estelle to verify the purchase amount.

response.speaker: Cornelia
response.text: But you don't need to worry about that. Just hurry and buy your keycap, I'll take care of the rest.

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: Thank you so much! You really are the best, Miss Cornelia. I'll go and buy it right now... Come on, Traveler, it's time to leave!

dialogues.speaker: Estelle
dialogues.text: Iaune, what is it? You seem to be out of breath.

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Estelle! Please, I need a keycap for a typewriter! You should have something here, right?

dialogues.speaker: Estelle
dialogues.text: Of course, but typewriters have so many different keys! Take a look and see which one you need a keycap for.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Iaune starts to rummage around, searching for the keycap he needs at lightning speed...

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: This one! This is it! Here's the money, thank you, Estelle!

dialogues.speaker: Estelle
dialogues.text: Last time, you said you'd like to go boating with me... Iaune! HEY! Iaune!

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Great! Now I can finally continue working. This proposal must be finished today!

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Thank you so much. When I have time, I will certainly treat you to an excellent meal!

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Are you free tomorrow? Come find me here if you've got the time.

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Wait for me to finish work, and we can all go eat a tasty meal!

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: You're right, I must work faster...

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: Wait, what's the next sentence? I should have written everything down...

talks.objective: Place the keycap on the typewriter

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: *sigh* ...Maybe I should just use "To my dear colleagues"...

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: A keycap for a typewriter... Hey, Semaine, can you even expense things like that?

dialogues.speaker: Semaine
dialogues.text: I am unclear. But if typewriters can be expensed... then it follows that the keycaps for the keys can be reimbursed as well.

dialogues.speaker: Cornelia
dialogues.text: Keycaps... They're not on our purchasing list of items eligible for reimbursements...

dialogues.speaker: Estelle
dialogues.text: What's he so busy with, anyway? *sigh* He really is...

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Cheer up, Iaune... You can handle it. You've definitely got this...
